image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a rough, encrusted rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with a visible series of overlapping dorsal plates surrounded by a leathery girdle. The background consists of pink coralline algae and other marine growth.
